K_verdict.rule: 017.26b section 11. Strong positive requires both fixtures and all seven criteria. Structural positive is criteria one to six with the labelled-data-burden criterion failing. K_verdict.why: on these finite worlds, ordinary typed source structure was sufficient for a generic exact compiler to derive useful invariance before labels, shrinking the statistical family learned from data

estimator.shared_by: every closed-form condition, refit from the same per-input counts

span_certificate.reading: the compiled family is inside the learners' hypothesis class, so any measured gap is inductive and computational and not a question of what the learner could represent

sufficiency_certificate.why_a_rule: fixed by rule rather than chosen, so no separation is selected to flatter any condition, and chosen only after the Phase S freeze was committed as 017.26b section 7 requires

wrong_compiler_control.construction: move the 2 lexicographically least members of each derived cell into the next cell cyclically, preserving every cardinality

span_certificate.reading: the compiled family is inside the learners' hypothesis class, so any measured gap is inductive and computational and not a question of what the learner could represent

sufficiency_certificate.why_a_rule: fixed by rule rather than chosen, so no separation is selected to flatter any condition, and chosen only after the Phase S freeze was committed as 017.26b section 7 requires

wrong_compiler_control.construction: move the 1 lexicographically least members of each derived cell into the next cell cyclically, preserving every cardinality

regimes.A: train and evaluate under the uniform distribution on every admitted input; exact expected loss in closed form
regimes.B: hold out whole input identities stratified by derived cell; train only on observations from the seen identities; evaluate exactly on the unseen ones

fences: no language-scale claim and no comparison to any language model
no physical Test Realization and no autonomous dynamics
OT is not claimed to be responsible for any measured gain; 017.25 and 017.25a established T = O = G for the measured statistical behaviour and nothing here disturbs it
neither fixture is representative of anything beyond itself
nothing was added to the stable decision-model public API

prediction_validation.method: the exact expectation must lie within four standard errors of the simulated mean for every closed-form condition in every regime A cell; the standard error is recovered from the reported confidence interval so the check is reproducible from the artifact alone
